_schema.description: Machine-readable execution sequence for autonomous master-plan completion. This sidecar references canonical Oyatie plan/checklist primitives instead of duplicating them.
_schema.authority_note: Execution overlay only; the doctrinal substrate (decision-principles.json + forbidden-operations.json + decision-rights.json + governance-amendment.json), docs/MASTERPLAN.md, ADRs, and checklist templates remain authoritative.

planning_hierarchy.milestone: multi-quarter outcome; M<NN>-slug; owns phase index and exit gate
planning_hierarchy.phase: 1-6 week deliverable; P<NN>-slug; owns entry/exit gates and dependency ordering
planning_hierarchy.implementation_plan: ChangeSet-sized executable phase-local slice; owns Oya VCS symbols/artifact pointers, issue-level scope, code shape, tests, evidence, handoff, and promotion eligibility

chained_enforcement_contract.summary: Fitness lanes must chain: detection of a banned primitive or aspirational-enforcement gap triggers a fixuptask and blocks promotion only after a real detector, workflow, branch-protection row, and source-corpus artifact exist on branch. The lane oya-foundry-fitness-banned-primitives is planned; its absence is itself a gap tracked as F-FORBIDDEN-PRIMITIVES-CI-GUARD.

repo_state_protocol.fallback: legacy grit/scaffold locks may record compatibility blockers only when the Oya VCS command surface is unavailable; they are not closure authority

repo_state_protocol.primitive: edit only inside isolated Oya VCS claimed workspace / ChangeSet boundary
repo_state_protocol.fallback: stop and narrow the ChangeSet on shared-symbol conflict

repo_state_protocol.primitive: run targeted then risk-scaled gates; package evidence, multispectrum review, provenance, and affected-test freshness into ChangeBundle
repo_state_protocol.fallback: record blocked check and next-best evidence in the ChangeBundle blocker section

repo_state_protocol.primitive: Oya VCS done seals the signed ChangeBundle and requests Promotion; local merge/done primitives are compatibility-only
repo_state_protocol.fallback: do not manually merge; report blocked Oya VCS closeout

repo_state_protocol.primitive: Oya VCS GitOps controller owns remote ref/PR-equivalent publication, CI/CD admission, review/fix, controller rebase, merge queue, environment reconciliation, and lock release
repo_state_protocol.fallback: keep/release locks according to terminal policy; never agent-run git/gh

early_prerequisites.compatibility_window: P00 core is complete and Oya VCS admission is required for forward agentic fan-out; legacy grit/icm may only preserve historical provenance or unblock a documented command-surface gap.

implementation_plan_changeset_contract.definition: Every ImplementationPlan is a ChangeSet-sized execution unit. It must be claimable, independently verifiable, bundleable, promotable, and small enough to avoid locking an entire tree without graph-proven rationale.
split_when: multiple independently deployable packages without shared invariant
whole-tree rebuild without declared full-gate reason
mixed provider adapter and kernel work without explicit contract boundary
review/fix task independent from original ChangeSet
